sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Segment = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.Segment) AS premium_percentage
FROM 
    gasstations AS T1
JOIN 
    customers AS T2 ON T1.ChainID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
    T1.Country = 'SVK'
